description: This file defines the class UserSettingsImplementation which implements user settings management, including event handling, notification registration, and value management for a user settings interface in a plugin architecture. It includes references to various external interfaces and internal nested classes for notifications and jobs.

classes.name: UserSettingsImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the IUserSettings interface, managing user preferences, notifications, and event handling within the plugin framework.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Nested class that implements the IStore2::INotification interface to handle value changes in the store and notify the parent UserSettingsImplementation.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Nested class representing asynchronous job tasks for dispatching events related to user settings changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for user settings changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the audio description setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Sets the preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Gets the preferred closed caption service.

methods.name: GetPinControl
methods.description: Checks if pin control is enabled.

methods.name: GetLiveWatershed
methods.description: Checks if live watershed is enabled.

methods.name: GetPlaybackWatershed
methods.description: Checks if playback watershed is enabled.

methods.name: SetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Sets blocking of not rated content.

methods.name: GetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Checks if blocking of not rated content is enabled.

methods.name: SetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Enables or disables pin requirement on purchase.

methods.name: GetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Checks if pin is required on purchase.
